name: Onboarding Tour is reachable from the sidebar and renders the clone-less prerequisite state
description: L06. The seeded stack has NO clone — seed.ts inserts acme/payments-api with clonePath: null and scripts/e2e.sh uses an ephemeral Postgres — so this flow asserts exactly the states a clone-less stack produces: the sidebar carries 'Onboarding Tour' in the WORKSPACE group and navigates to /repos/:repoId/onboarding (AC-2), and the page renders the prerequisite state naming the clone (AC-37). Read-only: nothing here writes, so the flow is re-runnable against a stack it does not own. A generation, a regeneration and a copy are NOT reachable without a real clone, and faking one would mean writing into server/clones/** — those are covered by the server integration lane. Two things this flow deliberately does not assert, because agent-browser's deterministic locators cannot: the ABSENCE of a Generate control (there is no negative assertion), and which sidebar item is highlighted (the active state is styling with no accessible attribute) — both are covered by the client suite instead.

steps.label: root redirects to a repo's PRs
sidebar entry navigates to the Onboarding Tour (AC-2)

cmd: This repository has no clone yet
steps.label: prerequisite state renders (AC-37)

cmd: The clone job has not finished for this repository
steps.label: the state names the clone as the missing prerequisite
the neighbouring WORKSPACE entry still navigates
the add-repository screen no longer owns /onboarding (AC-3)
